---
title: "Verification preparation checklist"
---

Technical documentation for modelling, result analysis and preparing a klimaaktiv declaration. These workflows address competence partners and declaration-standard users, energy/building/building-services designers, researchers and university teaching.

## Model setup and data

1. Define [project structure and system boundary](model.qmd).
2. Check [input data and interfaces](interfaces.qmd).
3. Document the [thermal boundary](envelope.qmd) and [component assignment](components.qmd).
4. Configure [energy supply and operation](systems.qmd).
5. Perform [calculation and variant management](excel-overview.qmd).

## Analysis and verification preparation

- [Heat, final-energy, primary-energy and GHG balances](examples.qmd) in variant comparison.
- [Aspern F7 electrical flows](examples.qmd#aspern-f7): seasonal daily profiles and chronological hourly values.
- [Mobility balance](mobility.qmd) and [life-cycle assessment](climate.qmd).
- [Declaration values, AUDIT and verification documents](declaration.qmd).

## Reproducible evaluations

[Python documentation](python.qmd) provides executable notebooks for import, analysis, visualisation and publication. Website and notebooks use the same implementation functions. The existing notebooks remain in German.
